alex: @here All-hands Thu 9:30am PT in the main auditorium + Zoom :spiral_calendar: Agenda draft below — please add Qs or drop them in the form. Recording and slides will be posted after. https://forms.gle/abcd1234

maya: I’ll cover rollout schedule, migration guidance, and customer case study. Need ~12 mins. Can someone grab 2 volunteers for demo callouts?

jordan: I’ll present Dedicated SLA changes + private deployment checklist. Also a short note on compliance integrations. cc: @security team for any last-minute items.

sam: Demo plan: show before/after with batching + kv-cache — target 90s total, 4 slides and a quick loadgen run. @eng-sre can you stand by Fri morning to validate scripts?

emily: I’ll run the AMA and take notes. If you have people ops questions DM me. Also arranging in-person catering :sandwich: — drop dietary prefs in the form.

alex: Please submit any demo/data access needs by EOD Wed. Link to slides draft: https://redwood.slides/spring-allhands (comment mode on)

allhands-bot: Reminder scheduled: Thu 9:00am PT (30m before). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/meet-allhands | Room: Main Auditorium. Calendar invites sent.

sam: Adding a short snippet of the loadgen command we’ll run:
```bash
./loadgen --model rdx-7b --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --duration 60
```

maya: Quick Q: want to include a 1-question live poll about routing preferences (latency vs cost)? thumbs up if yes.

alex: :thumbsup: do the poll. Also small ask — anyone with customer success notes on Private deployments pls DM me before the meeting.

jordan: Heads-up: planned low-risk maintenance Tue 2am PT that may briefly affect some Dedicated nodes; I'll share the advisory in #eng-infra.

emily: For remote folks — if you can’t attend we’ll post the recording + a 1-page TL;DR in #announcements. I’ll sync with comms after the meeting.

alex: Great — final agenda & pinned slides tomorrow morning. If you’ve added Qs to the form I’ll compile them into the AMA list. See you Thu :wave:
